prerequisites.feature: authority.local: a private AuthBoundry started beside the application, whose native server (@authboundry/core) makes every decision
prerequisites.whenAbsent: applications with authority.local cannot decide anything

prerequisites.feature: decisions prove the executor by its agent credential (executorProof.proven)
prerequisites.whenAbsent: decisions still decide; executorProof reads asserted (GUARANTEES)

prerequisites.feature: per-agent delegation: agent callers decide as themselves; grants name agents; ctx.authority.agents
prerequisites.whenAbsent: agent callers are refused (unavailable) by default; an owner may opt in to shared executor grants with authority.local.agentCallers: "executor-grants" (wider authority, recorded as local-executor-grants-opt-in, readiness warns)
those three operations refuse FAILED_PRECONDITION naming the release; list() works

prerequisites.detail: INVALID_QUERY: each condition requires a field and exactly one operator
prerequisites.whenAbsent: queries with `in` refuse FAILED_PRECONDITION naming the release; eq queries work
